summary: Requested a clean-copy re-execution of the heartbeat term-regression experiment (f13b5528eeb44ca99621e36f1c0f1ff0-experiment) to obtain a third independent measurement of its probabilistic result. That account currently rests on two rate runs of the same fixed inputs, 90 and 97 inversions out of 200 with a delayed stable-store write and none in either no-delay run, and the rate is the number a reader is most likely to reuse. The repeat runs the retained inputs unchanged in a clean copy, so it tests whether those counts are stable rather than a peculiarity of two runs. The conclusion does not hinge on the exact rate, but a materially different rate would change how the exposure is described and a missing effect would change the account, which is why the measurement is worth one more run. The submission validates with zero schema errors, names an existing fixed experiment whose harness is present, and requests one execution.
